Position
Cyber Security Consultant
Location
USA
Team
Cyber Security Services

About Sygnia 

Sygnia is a top-tier cyber technology and services company that partners with organizations around the world to proactively strengthen their cyber resilience and respond to advanced threats. We help companies prepare for and navigate cyber incidents with confidence, combining deep technical expertise with a business-driven mindset. 

Our services include strategic cybersecurity consulting, incident response, proactive security assessments, and Managed Detection and Response (MDR). Sygnia works with leading global enterprises, including Fortune 100 companies, across industries such as financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing, and critical infrastructure. 

With a team composed of elite cybersecurity professionals from military and commercial backgrounds, Sygnia delivers precision, speed, and impact when it matters most. 

The Role 

Sygnia is seeking a Cyber Security Consultant to join our growing Enterprise Security team in the United States. This is a highly technical consulting role focused on helping organizations assess, strengthen, and mature their cybersecurity programs through proactive security assessments and strategic advisory engagements. 

You will work alongside some of the industry's leading cybersecurity experts to evaluate enterprise environments, identify security risks, and provide practical recommendations that improve security posture across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructures. 

This is primarily a delivery-focused consulting role. Client relationship ownership is managed by Engagement Managers, allowing you to focus on delivering exceptional technical work while partnering closely with internal teams to ensure successful client outcomes. 

Experience with Operational Technology (OT) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) environments is highly valued as Sygnia continues expanding its capabilities across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors, though it is not required. 

What You'll Do 

  • Assess clients' security posture, enterprise architecture, technical configurations, and security controls to identify risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.  
  • Deliver proactive cybersecurity consulting engagements, including security assessments, architecture reviews, maturity evaluations, security roadmaps, and implementation guidance.  
  • Develop clear, actionable reports and present findings and recommendations to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.  
  • Provide practical guidance to help clients strengthen their security programs using industry best practices and risk-based recommendations.  
  • Support security incident response engagements and post-incident improvement initiatives as needed, representing approximately 20% of the role.  
  • Collaborate closely with Engagement Managers and technical specialists to ensure successful project delivery and exceptional client experience.  
  • Contribute to Sygnia's consulting methodologies, assessment frameworks, and internal knowledge sharing initiatives.  
  • Stay current on emerging threats, security technologies, and industry best practices to continuously enhance consulting capabilities.  
  • Support assessments involving cloud environments, identity security, enterprise infrastructure, and, when applicable, Operational Technology (OT) environments. 

What We're Looking For 

  • At least five years of experience as a cybersecurity professional.  
  • Previous hands-on experience in one or more technical cybersecurity disciplines such as security engineering, security architecture, cloud security, application security, infrastructure security, network security, or similar technical roles.  
  • Experience performing Operational Technology (OT) or Industrial Control Systems (ICS) security assessments.  
  • Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture, security design principles, and modern security controls across on-premises and cloud environments.  
  • Demonstrated experience assessing complex technical environments, identifying security gaps, and providing practical, risk-based recommendations.  
  • Strong client-facing consulting skills, including the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.  
  • Excellent written communication skills with experience developing professional assessment reports and technical deliverables.  
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a structured, consultative approach.  
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating across cross-functional technical teams.  
  • Willingness to travel approximately 20% for client engagements.  
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline. 

Bonus Points For 

  • Experience delivering cybersecurity consulting or professional services engagements.  
  • Strong knowledge of ICS/OT security architecture, with hands-on experience implementing and configuring cybersecurity controls and industry standards. 
  • Familiarity with industrial control environments, manufacturing, utilities, energy, or critical infrastructure, including standards such as IEC62443 and NERC-CIP. 
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, OSCP, CEH, CCSP, CCSK, GIAC certifications, cloud security certifications, or equivalent technical expertise.  
  • Experience presenting findings and recommendations to senior leadership or executive stakeholders.  
  • Knowledge of industry frameworks such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, MITRE ATT&CK, or similar cybersecurity standards. 
  • Fluency in Spanish.

Why Sygnia 

Joining Sygnia means working alongside some of the world's most respected cybersecurity professionals on complex engagements that help organizations strengthen their resilience against evolving cyber threats. 

You will have the opportunity to: 

  • Solve complex security challenges for leading global organizations.  
  • Work alongside experts in incident response, adversarial tactics, enterprise security, and cyber strategy.  
  • Gain exposure to diverse industries, technologies, and enterprise environments.  
  • Continue developing your technical expertise through challenging consulting engagements and continuous learning.  
  • Help organizations improve their security posture before incidents occur and make a measurable impact on their long-term resilience.

Position
Incident Response Manager
Location
Israel
Team
Cyber Security Services

Sygnia is the foremost global cyber readiness and response team, applying creative approaches and battle-tested solutions to help organizations beat attackers and stay secure. With a team of deep digital combat, leading- edge, purpose-built technology, and enterprise security specialists, it enables companies to proactively build cyber resilience and defeat attacks within their networks. Sygnia is a trusted advisor and service provider of technology and security teams, executives and boards of leading organizations worldwide. Sygnia supports clients at each stage of their security journey, bringing frontline experience and technological acumen to help them be unstoppable in the face of cyber threats.

The company draws on top talent from the ranks of elite military technology units and from across the cyber industry and has some of the world’s top talents in cyber security. Described by Forbes as a “cyber security delta force”, it applies technological supremacy, digital combat experience, data analytics and a business-driven mindset to cyber security, enabling organizations to excel in the age of cyber.

Sygnia is looking for an experienced Incident Response Manager (IRM) to lead incident response services for clients across EMEA. This is a senior management role within Sygnia’s Incident Response department and an integral part of the company’s global IR service delivery organization.

The role combines technical leadership, crisis management, client engagement, and cross-functional project leadership. Following a substantial and successful tenure in the position, the IRM will have opportunities for continued professional growth and advancement across a variety of roles within Sygnia.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead incident response and threat-hunting engagements involving large-scale and sophisticated cyberattacks, with the objective of containing, mitigating, and defeating real-world threats.
  • Lead dynamic, cross-functional teams of cybersecurity researchers, forensic experts, and other specialists assembled according to the specific needs of each engagement. Team members do not report directly to the IRM outside the scope of the project.
  • Maintain clear, concise, and timely internal communication, providing regular updates to technical, financial, legal, business, and executive stakeholders within Sygnia.
  • Lead client-facing communication throughout investigations and work closely with clients’ IT, security, legal, and executive teams, as well as relevant external stakeholders.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients during high-pressure and business-critical situations.
  • Collaborate with Sygnia’s global teams to ensure consistent, high-quality incident response delivery across regions.
  • Strengthen client relationships, identify relevant business opportunities, and support the introduction of additional Sygnia services.
  • Contribute to Sygnia’s broader strategic objectives through professional publications, thought leadership, marketing initiatives, and business development activities.
  • Design, develop, and continuously improve internal incident response methodologies, processes, and capabilities.


Main Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience leading teams through direct management, project-based leadership, matrix management, or a combination of these models.
  • Proven ability to lead diverse groups of specialists who do not report directly to the role, while maintaining alignment, accountability, and effective execution.
  • A decisive, intellectually sharp, and positive leader with a strong commitment to excellence.
  • Calm and thoughtful leadership style, with the ability to make sound decisions in highly dynamic and fast-paced environments.
  • Strong crisis-management capabilities, including the ability to objectively assess situations, manage complex stakeholder relationships, and continuously evaluate actions and priorities.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills in English, with the ability to explain complex technical matters clearly and confidently to both technical professionals and executive leadership. Additional languages are an advantage.
  • In-depth understanding of advanced cyber threats, attack vectors, adversary techniques, and exploitation methods.
  • Strong technical knowledge of network fundamentals, common internet protocols, operating systems, and security controls.
  • Familiarity with the tools and techniques used in security event analysis, incident response, digital forensics, malware analysis, and broader security operations.
  • Ability to work in a project-based model involving urgent and unplanned engagements, including availability outside regular working hours and on weekends when required.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as needed.
  • Previous experience in strategy or cybersecurity consulting is an advantage.
  • An academic degree in a technological or scientific discipline is an advantage.

Position
Threat Intelligence Researcher
Location
Israel
Team
Cyber Security Services

Sygnia is a top-tier cyber technology and services company providing consulting, incident response support, threat intelligence, and monitoring services for organizations worldwide. Sygnia works with companies to proactively build their cyber resilience and to respond to and defeat attacks within their networks. It is the trusted advisor and cybersecurity service provider of IT and security teams, senior management, and boards of leading organizations worldwide, including Fortune 100 companies.

The company draws on top talent from elite military technology units and across the cybersecurity industry and is home to some of the world’s top cyber experts. Described by Forbes as a “cyber security delta force,” Sygnia applies technological superiority, digital combat experience, data analytics, and a business-driven mindset to help organizations excel in the age of cyber.

Sygnia is looking for a Threat Intelligence Researcher to join its Threat Intelligence Group and support the company’s Cyber Threat Intelligence Exposure Management (CTIEM) services, Incident Response engagement and proactive services. In this position, you will identify, investigate, and monitor external cyber threats and organizational exposures across the open web, dark web, social media platforms, and other intelligence sources. You will help organizations understand and reduce their external attack surface, detect brand abuse and malicious activity targeting their assets, and develop innovative intelligence-driven monitoring capabilities leveraging automation and AI technologies.

The successful candidate should be a creative, highly motivated, and independent researcher with strong analytical skills, a deep understanding of attacker methodologies, and a passion for solving complex intelligence challenges. As part of the role, you will engage with clients, support operational teams, and contribute to the development of cutting-edge CTIEM capabilities.

Main Responsibilities

  • Conduct proactive monitoring and investigations across the open web, dark web, forums, marketplaces, messaging platforms, and social media channels to identify threats targeting client organizations.
  • Analyze organizational exposure across external attack surfaces, including internet-facing assets, leaked information, exposed services, and emerging risks.
  • Investigate and identify brand abuse activities, impersonation attempts, phishing campaigns, fraudulent domains, and other malicious activities targeting clients.
  • Detect and assess data exposures and information leaks through a variety of intelligence sources, commercial platforms, and proprietary tools.
  • Utilize Attack Surface Management (ASM) platforms and related technologies to identify, prioritize, and assess external security exposures.
  • Develop and enhance intelligence collection, detection, and monitoring capabilities through automation and AI-driven solutions, primarily using Python.
  • Produce comprehensive intelligence reports, exposure assessments, and actionable recommendations for clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Engage directly with clients to present findings, explain risks, and support remediation efforts.
  • Collaborate closely with Incident Response teams to support ongoing investigations.

Main Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence, Exposure Management, Threat Research, Cyber Investigations, or related cybersecurity domains.
  • Proven experience conducting investigations across open web, dark web, and social media intelligence sources.
  • Strong understanding of attacker methodologies with emphasis on reconnaissance, phishing, credential theft, social engineering, and initial access techniques.
  • Experience with Attack Surface Management (ASM), External Attack Surface Management (EASM), Digital Risk Protection (DRP), or related technologies.
  • Experience identifying brand abuse, impersonation campaigns, phishing infrastructure, and malicious domain activity.
  • Familiarity with data leak investigations, exposed credentials monitoring, and external exposure analysis.
  • Hands-on experience developing automation, intelligence collection, or detection capabilities using Python.
  • Strong analytical and investigative mindset with the ability to connect disparate pieces of information into meaningful intelligence.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical findings clearly to clients and executives.
  • Self-motivated, independent, and accountable, with the ability to manage investigations from initiation through delivery.
  • Team player with strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach.

Position
Incident Response Expert
Location
Israel
Team
Incident Response

﻿Sygnia is the foremost global cyber readiness and response team, applying creative approaches and battle-tested solutions to help organizations beat attackers and stay secure. With a team of deep digital combat, leading- edge, purpose-built technology, and enterprise security specialists, it enables companies to proactively build cyber resilience and defeat attacks within their networks. Sygnia is a trusted advisor and service provider of technology and security teams, executives and boards of leading organizations worldwide. Sygnia supports clients at each stage of their security journey, bringing frontline experience and technological acumen to help them be unstoppable in the face of cyber threats.

The company draws on top talent from the ranks of elite military technology units and from across the cyber industry and has some of the world’s top talents in cyber security. Described by Forbes as a “cyber security delta force”, it applies technological supremacy, digital combat experience, data analytics and a business-driven mindset to cyber security, enabling organizations to excel in the age of cyber.

Cyber threats are constantly growing in volume, velocity and sophistication. When an organization is confronted with an advanced attack, it needs the strongest capabilities on its side. In many cases, an incident response engagement is in fact a battle within a network. The operational art, experience focus and speed of Sygnia response teams can mean the difference between a minor blow and a devastating impact on performance and reputation of organizations.

Sygnia is looking for highly capable Incident Response Expert. The Incident Response Expert role includes conducting in-depth forensic analysis, investigation and response to real-world cyber threats. A significant part of our investigations is performed onsite at the client location, in collaboration with the client’s IT and security teams.

Main Responsibilities

  • Participate in forensic and incident response investigations, including large scale sophisticated attacks, conduct log analysis, host and network-based forensics and malware analysis.
  • Participate in threat hunting: proactively hunt for targeted attacks and new emerging threats in client’s networks; as well as security assessments and simulations.
  • Identify indicators of compromise (IOCs) and tools, tactics, and procedures (TTPs) to help ascertain whether and how breaches have occurred.
  • Utilize and develop tools and methodologies to improve Sygnia’s existing investigative and hunting technological stack.
  • Collaborate with IT and Security teams during investigations.
  • Generate and present a comprehensive and professional report of findings from investigations.

Main Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of a relevant experience (from military service and/or industry).
  • Bright, curious and determined team player, who strive for excellency.
  • Problem solver, in-depth thinker with growth mindset.
  • Demonstrated in-depth understanding of the life cycle of advanced security threats, attack vectors and variant methods of exploration.
  • Deep technical understanding of network fundamentals and common Internet protocols.
  • Solid understanding of system and security controls on at least two OSs (Windows, Linux / Unix and MacOS), including host-based forensics and experience with analyzing OS artifacts.
  • Fluency with one or more scripting language (i.e. Python).
  • Multidisciplinary knowledge and competencies, such as:
  • Hands-on experience in data analysis (preferably network traffic or log analysis) in relevant data analysis and data science platforms (Jupyter, Splunk, pandas, SQL).
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, web application and servers, android and iOS mobile platforms.
  • Experience with malware analysis and reverse engineering.
  • Familiarity with enterprise SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, QR.adar, ArcSight).
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Fluent English, including the ability to document and explain technical information in a concise, understandable manner.

Position
Director of Product Management
Location
Israel
Team
R&D

Sygnia is a leading cyber security company, helping organizations proactively manage cyber risk, detect advanced threats, and respond to the most sophisticated cyberattacks worldwide. Trusted by Fortune 100 companies, global enterprises, and critical infrastructure organizations, Sygnia combines elite cyber expertise, advanced technology, and deep operational experience to deliver measurable security outcomes.

At the heart of Sygnia's managed security business is Velocity, Sygnia's Threat Detection Investigation and Response (TDIR) platform. Velocity combines automated expert-led threat detection, threat hunting, incident response expertise, proprietary detection capabilities, and advanced automation to provide continuous protection against modern cyber threats.

As cyberattacks become increasingly automated and AI-driven, Sygnia is investing heavily in the evolution of Velocity into an AI-native security operations platform. By combining human expertise, threat intelligence, AI-powered investigation, and security automation, Velocity is redefining how organizations detect, investigate, and respond to threats at scale.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Director of Product Management to lead the strategy, vision, and execution of Sygnia’s technology.

This is a highly strategic leadership role with responsibility for shaping the future of AI-powered Managed Detection and Response. You will work closely with executive leadership, Security Research, Incident Response, Detection Engineering, Customer Success, and Engineering teams to define the next generation of MDR capabilities and drive Velocity's growth and market differentiation.

The successful candidate will combine strong product leadership experience, deep cybersecurity expertise, and a passion for leveraging AI to transform security operations.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Velocity TDIR platform.
  • Lead the evolution of Velocity into an AI-powered security operations platform, incorporating Generative AI, AI Agents, automation, and advanced analytics to improve detection, investigation, and response.
  • Own product business performance, including adoption, customer satisfaction, retention, competitive positioning, and growth.
  • Drive the development of innovative MDR capabilities that improve security outcomes, analyst productivity, and operational scalability.
  • Partner closely with Security Research, Detection Engineering, Threat Intelligence, and Incident Response teams to transform emerging threats and attacker techniques into differentiated product capabilities.
  • Oversee the end-to-end product lifecycle, from concept and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  • Continuously assess market trends, customer requirements, and the competitive landscape to identify growth opportunities and strategic investments.
  • Engage directly with customers and strategic prospects to understand their challenges, validate product direction, and strengthen market positioning.
  • Serve as a product evangelist, representing Velocity's vision and capabilities with customers, partners, analysts, and industry forums.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to ensure scalable, secure, and high-quality product delivery.
  • Manage product investments and priorities to maximize customer value and business impact.


Requirements

  • 7–10+ years of product management experience, including 3–5+ years leading product teams or major product initiatives.
  • Deep understanding of modern security operations, including MDR, SOC workflows, threat hunting, detection engineering, incident response, SIEM, XDR, EDR, and security automation.
  • Proven experience defining and delivering AI/ML or Generative AI-powered products and capabilities.
  • Strong technical background with the ability to engage effectively with engineering, data science, and cybersecurity teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to define and communicate a compelling product vision and execute against long-term strategic objectives.
  • Experience building and scaling enterprise cybersecurity or SaaS products.
  • Strong customer-facing skills and experience working directly with enterprise customers.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment across complex organizations.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills in both English and Hebrew.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a track record of delivering measurable business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in MDR, XDR, SOC, or security operations environments.
  • Experience building products that leverage AI Agents, workflow automation, or autonomous investigation capabilities.
  • MBA or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

Success will be measured by:

  • Growth and adoption of the Velocity platform.
  • Delivery of differentiated AI-powered MDR capabilities.
  • Improvements in analyst efficiency and operational scalability.
  • Enhanced customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Expansion of Velocity's competitive advantage and market position.
  • Achievement of strategic product and business objectives.

About Sygnia 

Sygnia is a leading cyber technology and services company that partners with organizations around the world to strengthen cyber resilience and respond to sophisticated threats. We help companies prepare for and navigate cyber incidents with confidence, combining deep technical expertise with a business-driven approach. 

Our services include incident response, cyber readiness, security consulting, proactive security assessments, and managed detection and response (MDR). Sygnia works with leading global enterprises, including Fortune 100 companies, across industries such as financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing, and critical infrastructure. 

With a team of experienced cybersecurity professionals and frontline practitioners, Sygnia delivers the expertise, speed, and strategic guidance organizations need when facing today’s most complex cyber threats. 

The Role 

Sygnia is seeking a Bilingual Customer Success Manager to support customers of its Incident Response Readiness (IRR) service across North America and Latin America. 

This is a newly established strategic role and part of Sygnia’s global investment in customer retention, value realization, and long-term client success. The position was created to ensure customers remain actively engaged throughout the lifecycle of their IRR partnership, maximize the value of their service, and are well positioned for successful renewal. 

This position supports a retainer-based incident readiness service. Customers rely on Sygnia not only during cyber incidents, while also engaging proactively throughout the partnership to strengthen preparedness, improve response readiness, and leverage prepaid service hours to address evolving security priorities.  

The ideal candidate combines strong customer success and relationship management experience with technical cybersecurity knowledge, business acumen, and the ability to serve as a trusted advisor to security leaders and executive stakeholders. 

What You’ll Do 

Customer Onboarding & Readiness Alignment 

  • Lead onboarding activities for new IRR customers, introducing Sygnia’s incident response methodology, activation procedures, and service capabilities. 
  • Develop an understanding of each customer’s environment, including security architecture, technology stack, key stakeholders, escalation paths, and operational processes. 
  • Establish success plans and engagement strategies that align Sygnia’s services with customer objectives and security priorities. 

Customer Engagement & Value Realization 

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for IRR customers and build trusted relationships with technical, operational, and executive stakeholders. 
  • Drive ongoing customer engagement through regular check-ins, readiness reviews, business reviews, and strategic planning discussions. 
  • Help customers maximize the value of their IRR service by identifying opportunities to utilize prepaid hours for readiness activities, advisory engagements, proactive services, and incident preparedness initiatives. 
  • Ensure customers understand and leverage the full breadth of Sygnia’s capabilities throughout the lifecycle of the engagement. 
  • Monitor customer health, engagement levels, service utilization, and satisfaction to proactively identify risks and opportunities. 

Retention & Renewal Success 

  • Own renewal readiness activities throughout the customer lifecycle. 
  • Identify potential renewal risks early and develop mitigation strategies in partnership with internal stakeholders. 
  • Track and communicate customer outcomes, service value, and business impact to support long-term retention. 
  • Partner with Sales and delivery teams to ensure customers achieve measurable value from their investment in Sygnia. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Delivery, Operations, and Regional Leadership to deliver an exceptional customer experience. 
  • Support customer escalations and coordinate internal resources to address issues efficiently and effectively. 
  • Help shape and mature Sygnia’s global Customer Success function, processes, engagement models, and best practices. 


What We’re Looking For 

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Strategic Account Management, or similar customer-facing role within a cybersecurity organization. 
  • Strong cybersecurity knowledge and the ability to engage credibly with security practitioners, security leadership, and executive stakeholders. 
  • Experience supporting enterprise and mid-market customers across a variety of industries and technical environments. 
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships and maintain high levels of customer engagement throughout long-term service engagements. 
  • Experience managing retainer-based services, recurring service agreements, or ongoing advisory relationships. 
  • Strong understanding of enterprise security technologies and security operations, including endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and detection and response capabilities. 
  • Demonstrated ability to identify customer risks, develop success plans, and drive measurable customer outcomes. 
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple customer relationships simultaneously. 
  • High level of ownership, accountability, and independent decision-making. 
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across sales, operations, delivery, and leadership teams. 
  • Fluency in Spanish and English.

Bonus Points For 

  • Experience working within incident response, cyber readiness, managed security services, MDR, SOC, or security consulting environments. 
  • Experience supporting incident response retainers or similar subscription-based cybersecurity services. 
  • Familiarity with Customer Success methodologies, health scoring frameworks, lifecycle management, executive business reviews, and customer reporting. 
  • Experience working with enterprise security teams, CISOs, and executive stakeholders. 
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Security+, or related cybersecurity credentials. 

Why Sygnia 

  • Join a newly created strategic function with significant visibility and impact across the organization. 
  • Help shape the future of Sygnia’s global customer success strategy and customer retention programs. 
  • Work with some of the world's most sophisticated organizations as they strengthen their cyber resilience. 
  • Collaborate with leading cybersecurity experts across incident response, readiness, proactive security services, and MDR. 
  • Make a measurable impact on customer outcomes, retention, and long-term business growth. 
  • Be part of a fast-growing global cybersecurity company that combines technical excellence with a strong client-first culture.

Position
Security Operations Center Analyst
Location
Austin, Texas
Team
Velocity MDR

About Sygnia

Sygnia is a top-tier cyber technology and services company that partners with organizations around the world to proactively strengthen their cyber resilience and respond to advanced threats. We help companies prepare for and navigate cyber incidents with confidence, combining deep technical expertise with a business-driven mindset.

Our services include strategic cybersecurity consulting, incident response, proactive security assessments, and Managed Detection and Response (MDR). Sygnia works with leading global enterprises, including Fortune 100 companies, across industries such as finance, healthcare, technology, and critical infrastructure.

With a team composed of elite cybersecurity professionals from military and commercial backgrounds, Sygnia delivers precision, speed, and impact when it matters most.

The Role

﻿Sygnia is looking for a Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst to join our growing U.S. Managed Detection and Response team in Austin, Texas.

This is an exciting opportunity to help build Sygnia's first U.S. MDR site as we expand our global follow-the-sun operating model. You will work alongside experienced cybersecurity professionals to investigate security events, perform threat hunting, improve detection capabilities, and help protect some of the world's leading organizations.

As a SOC Analyst, you will leverage Sygnia's proprietary Velocity platform to monitor client environments, investigate alerts, and identify emerging threats. This is a hands-on technical role that combines security monitoring, incident investigation, detection engineering, and customer interaction.

This position is onsite in Austin five days per week and follows a rotating Sunday through Friday schedule to support global MDR operations.

What You'll Do

  • Monitor client environments using Sygnia's proprietary Velocity platform to identify, investigate, and respond to security events.
  • Perform in-depth alert triage, incident investigation, and threat analysis while meeting defined service level objectives.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting to identify malicious activity that may evade traditional detections.
  • Differentiate legitimate security incidents from false positives and determine appropriate response actions.
  • Develop and improve detection logic, correlation rules, and use cases to strengthen monitoring capabilities.
  • Correlate data from multiple security technologies and log sources to identify complex attack activity.
  • Work closely with clients by providing timely updates, incident reports, and actionable security recommendations.
  • Collaborate with senior analysts and MDR leadership to maintain high investigation quality and continuously improve operational processes.
  • Identify opportunities to automate workflows and improve the efficiency of MDR operations.
  • Recommend improvements to client visibility, security monitoring, and overall security posture.

What We're Looking For

  • At least two years of experience in a SOC, MDR, Managed EDR, or security operations environment.
  • Hands-on experience investigating security alerts and responding to security incidents.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Understanding of modern cyber threats, attack techniques, and common attacker methodologies.
  • Experience working with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, ArcSight, Exabeam, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with common enterprise security technologies including EDR, firewalls, Windows Event Logs, identity platforms, and network security controls.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, operating systems, and enterprise security architecture.
  • Basic knowledge of host-based forensics, operating system artifacts, and security event analysis.
  • Experience with scripting or automation using Python or similar languages.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical teammates and customers.
  • Willingness to work an onsite rotating schedule in Austin, including Sunday through Friday coverage as part of Sygnia's follow-the-sun MDR model.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with detection engineering or SIEM content development.
  • Familiarity with digital forensics, malware analysis, or incident response.
  • Experience working within an MSSP or MDR provider.

Why Sygnia

  • Help build Sygnia's first U.S. MDR site and play a foundational role in its long-term success.
  • Investigate sophisticated cyber threats affecting some of the world's leading organizations.
  • Work alongside experienced incident responders, threat hunters, and cybersecurity experts.
  • Gain exposure to a wide variety of enterprise environments, industries, and attack scenarios.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Sygnia's proprietary Velocity platform and MDR capabilities.
  • Join a collaborative team that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and innovation.
  • Grow your career with opportunities to expand into advanced monitoring, incident response, threat hunting, and leadership roles.

Sygnia is looking for an experienced MDR Site Team Lead to join our MDR Operations team in Singapore. This is a hands-on technical leadership role combining people management with advanced security operations. The Team Lead will manage and develop a team of MDR Analysts while serving as the senior technical authority on shift and the first point of escalation for complex investigations and high-severity security events. Working closely with the MDR Site Manager and Sygnia’s global MDR teams, the Team Lead will be responsible for maintaining high technical standards, meeting client SLAs, ensuring effective Follow-the-Sun operations, and continuously improving our detection and response capabilities.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead, manage, and professionally develop a team of MDR Analysts, providing ongoing technical coaching, mentoring, and performance feedback.
  • Manage team scheduling, shift coverage, and on-call allocation to support 24/7 Follow-the-Sun operations.
  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex investigations and high-severity security events.
  • Manage alert queues and priorities, ensuring acknowledgement, investigation, and escalation are handled in accordance with client SLAs.
  • Monitor operational performance, identify potential SLA risks or bottlenecks, and proactively rebalance workloads when required.
  • Ensure effective cross-region shift handovers, including open investigations, client communications, and outstanding operational tasks.
  • Lead and support in-depth security investigations, including log-based forensic analysis across endpoint, network, identity, email, cloud, and application environments.
  • Continuously improve detection capabilities by tuning existing logic, reducing false positives, and translating threat intelligence and post-incident findings into new or enhanced detections.
  • Review analysts’ investigations, escalations, reports, and client communications to ensure technical accuracy, completeness, consistency, and professionalism.
  • Act as a technical point of contact for clients during security events, clearly communicating findings, risks, status updates, and recommended actions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Produce and review client-ready incident and investigation reports, including timelines, root cause, impact assessments, and remediation recommendations.
  • Serve as the focal point between MDR and Incident Response teams when critical events require transition to full Incident Response.
  • Develop and maintain MDR procedures, runbooks, knowledge articles, and client-specific documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve MDR processes, methodologies, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the MDR Site Manager with ongoing operational activities and act on their behalf when required.


Main Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in SOC, MDR, or MSSP environments, including security monitoring, investigation, detection, and incident response.
  • 1+ years of experience leading or directly managing security analysts, including technical mentoring, performance management, and shift or resource planning.
  • Strong hands-on investigation experience across SIEM, EDR/XDR, network, identity, email, cloud, and endpoint telemetry.
  • Experience with forensic and incident response investigations, including host, network, and cloud log analysis.
  • Strong understanding of security threats, attacker behavior, investigation methodologies, and incident response processes.
  • Experience building, tuning, and improving detection scenarios and correlation logic.
  • Hands-on experience investigating security events in at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Experience analyzing network security telemetry, including firewalls, WAF, proxy, and DNS logs.
  • Experience investigating EDR/XDR, Windows, Sysmon, identity, and email security telemetry.
  • Familiarity with malware analysis and threat intelligence enrichment.
  • Proven ability to produce high-quality incident and investigation reports for external clients.
  • Experience working in a 24/7 or Follow-the-Sun operational environment.
  • Strong leadership and coaching capabilities, with the ability to develop analysts while maintaining high technical and operational standards.
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to lead technical discussions with clients, including during high-pressure incidents.
  • Strong judgment, prioritization, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage multiple competing client priorities and SLAs.
  • Proactive, accountable, and improvement-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to support escalations and critical events outside regular working hours when required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Advantages

  • Previous experience working for an MSSP or MDR provider.
  • Relevant cybersecurity certifications.
  • Knowledge of Python for security automation and analysis.
  • Experience with SQL for querying security, log, or case-management datasets.
